title: bitbucket fetch_reviews
description: One review, built by the connector. APPROVED and COMMENTED come from the pull request activity feed. CHANGES_REQUESTED comes from a participant's current state, dated at the pull request's creation.

user.description: The reviewer. Each key is an empty string when Bitbucket sent no user.

pr_id.description: Pull request id, as a decimal string.

created_on.description: RFC 3339 in UTC, to the second.
